name: Waffle Chart
description: A ten-by-ten unit chart of who closed each support ticket: switch quarters and the cells fly to their new group on springs while the counts roll.

props.name: groups
props.type: { key: string; label: string; note?: string }[]
props.description: The categories, in fill order. The first takes the accent; the rest step down a grey ramp. Up to five read well.

props.name: periods
props.type: { key: string; label: string; caption?: string; counts: number[] }[]
props.description: One count per group. Positive finite counts are rounded to 100 cells by largest remainder. Negative or nonfinite values count as zero; an all-zero period shows the empty state.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown for an empty groups or periods array and periods with no positive finite counts. No cells or percentages are invented.

props.name: onPeriodChange
props.description: Called when the period tab changes.

props.name: unit
props.description: Singular noun for one cell, used in the headline, hover readout and labels.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fill the grid column by column (groups read as bands) or row by row.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the first group's cells, swatch and headline figure.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or a white card with near-black ink.
